analysis.method: Exact canonical subinterval partition; bounded polyline swept by fixed edge; analytic segment-to-convex-polygon distance
analysis.overlap_semantics: Zero/near-zero approximate distance is possible contact/overlap, not a certified positive overlap area
analysis.own_attachment_semantics: Expected same-occurrence contact remains reported, never removed by ignoring the entire parent stroke
limitations: no path access or curvature feasibility proof
no approved overlap area or contributor exemption for new ink
no actual ink, pressure or motion envelope
